lines.text: For we are consumed by Your anger
You have set our iniquities before You,
our secret sins in the light of Your presence.
For all our days decline in Your fury;
we finish our years with a sigh.
The length of our days is seventy years—
or eighty if we are strong—
yet their pride is but labor and sorrow,
for they quickly pass, and we fly away.
Who knows the power of Your anger?
Your wrath matches the fear You are due.
So teach us to number our days,
that we may present a heart of wisdom.

pictures.scene: Claude-Joseph Vernet, A Shipwreck in Stormy Seas — the dismasted ship going down under a black sky split by lightning while the survivors cling to the rocks, for we are consumed by Your anger and terrified by Your wrath
pictures.name: pd_vernet_toorn

pictures.scene: Hieronymus Bosch, The Seven Deadly Sins and the Four Last Things — the eye of God opened in the middle of the wheel with the warning written in it that God sees, You have set our iniquities before You, our secret sins in the light of Your presence
pictures.name: pd_bosch_zonden

pictures.scene: Ferdinand Hodler, Die Lebensmüden — the old men sitting bowed in a row with their hands folded and nothing left to say, for all our days decline in Your fury, we finish our years with a sigh
pictures.name: pd_hodler_zucht

pictures.scene: Titian, Allegory of Prudence — the three faces of one life set side by side, the young man, the man in his strength, and the old man already turning away, the length of our days is seventy years, or eighty if we are strong
pictures.name: pd_titiaan_zeventig

pictures.scene: Józef Chełmoński, Bociany — the old man and the boy in the flowering meadow looking up at the storks going over them and away, yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for they quickly pass, and we fly away
pictures.name: pd_chelmonski_vliegen

pictures.scene: Georges Michel, L'Orage sur la vallée de la Seine — the torn storm sky coming down over the whole valley with the windmill small underneath it, who knows the power of Your anger, Your wrath matches the fear You are due
pictures.name: pd_michel_kracht

pictures.scene: Henry Ossawa Tanner, Nicodemus Visiting Jesus — the teacher and the old man sitting together on the moonlit roof over Jerusalem with the whole night to talk in, so teach us to number our days, that we may present a heart of wisdom
pictures.name: pd_tanner_tellen
